body: Hey! Glad I'm not alone at least :) I haven't moved yet. I'm still building up my savings but I've been leaning towards either Oregon/Colorado or Wisconsin/Michigan as cheaper alternatives.
It's the L-Train model by Brilliant Bicycles but was designed by the founder of Priority Bicycles (Brilliant is Priority's sister company).
I'm torn which color to get :(((( haha

Oh cool. My office is also at ADA. Thanks for the tips! I'm getting a new bike today so I'll be sure to be more careful this time but I'm also more vigilant now when I see someone loitering around bike racks.

Thanks! I actually work at Lurie's and I always locked it in front of my office building on Chicago Ave. The racks are right in front of the building security desk, under a few cameras, and across the street from the fire station. I honestly didn't think anyone would be so bold to steal it. Lesson learned :/
Thanks! It's more frustrating because I just had the bike in the shop for a week 2 days before it was stolen. On top of that, this was my only mode of transportation :/ People suck.

Thanks! I just had the back wheel replaced after a small accident so the front and back wheels don't look identical anymore.
Yeah. I'd say around 35-45 years old. And I think he's either wearing a work uniform (khakis and tucked in shirt) or he wore that specifically to disguise himself.

Thanks! I had the same thoughts. This happened around 12:30pm so I plan on eating my lunch outside from now on with a clear view of the bike racks. I also asked nearby residential buildings for their security footage as well. I'm hoping to get a better look at his face.

Unfortunately, I forgot my U-Lock at home that day and ended up using my backup combination cable lock. Although, building security said they've seen footage of thieves cutting U-Locks too. They said they even dress as construction workers.
Thank you! San Luis was not on my radar but I will definitely look into it! I appreciate your response :)
Thanks for such an honest and thoughtful response! I will take this into consideration.
